```python
def test_e1_frame_consistency_end_to_end_through_build_replay(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """F1 regression (end-to-end): drive the FULL public build_replay() function
    and verify the frames embedded in the generated HTML are E1-consistent with
    the independent oracle. This is the review's core demand — an E1 test
    through build_replay() itself, not a private-frame injection."""
    from market_game_sim.replay.generate import build_replay

    OracleKernel.instances.clear()
    monkeypatch.setattr(runner_mod, "EventKernel", OracleKernel)
    cfg = ExperimentConfig(
        seed=3,
        max_transactions=120,
        agent_specs=[_mm_spec(), _belief_spec()],
        agent_signals={"agent-0": 10_000},
    )
    result = run_one(cfg)
    assert result.terminated == "COMPLETED", f"abort: {result.abort_code}"

    kernel = OracleKernel.instances[-1]
    oracle_frames = kernel.oracle_frames

    log_path = tmp_path / "run.jsonl"
    out_path = tmp_path / "replay.html"
    _write_log(log_path, result, cfg)
    build_replay(log_path, out_path)

    html = out_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    marker = 'type="application/json">'
    start = html.index(marker) + len(marker)
    end = html.index("</script>", start)
    data = json.loads(html[start:end])

    bootstrap_txn = _bootstrap_txn(result.events)
    embedded_frames = data["frames"]
    assert len(embedded_frames) == len(oracle_frames) - bootstrap_txn + 1, (
        f"end-to-end frame count {len(embedded_frames)} != oracle frames-{bootstrap_txn}+1 "
        f"({len(oracle_frames) - bootstrap_txn + 1})"
    )
    for k, frame in enumerate(embedded_frames):
        _assert_frame_equal(_reconstitute_frame(frame), oracle_frames[bootstrap_txn + k - 1], k)
```

```js
  page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') consoleErrors.push(m.text()); });
  page.on('pageerror', e => pageErrors.push(String(e)));
  page.on('requestfailed', r => failedRequests.push(r.url()));
  page.on('request', r => { if (!r.url().startsWith('file://')) failedRequests.push('non-file request: ' + r.url()); });

  const url = 'file:///C:/Users/Georg/AppData/Local/Temp/opencode/t403_offline_test/replay.html';
  await page.goto(url, { waitUntil: 'load' });
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);

  // Verify frame info updates
  const frameInfo = await page.textContent('#frame-info');
  // Interact: pause
  await page.click('#btn-pause');
  await page.waitForTimeout(300);
  const btnText = await page.textContent('#btn-pause');
  // speed change
  await page.fill('#speed', '3');  // range input — use evaluate to set + dispatch
  await page.evaluate(() => { const s = document.getElementById('speed'); s.value = '3'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); });
  await page.waitForTimeout(200);
  // timeline seek

  const frameInfo2 = await page.textContent('#frame-info');
  // liquidation marks presence (data may or may not have liq; check element exists)

  // K-line canvas rendered

    klineCanvas: !!klineCanvas, bookCanvas: !!bookCanvas, accountCanvas: !!accountCanvas, priceCanvas: !!priceCanvas, liqEl: !!liqEl,
    consoleErrors, pageErrors, failedRequests,
  };
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  await browser.close();
})();
```
